about: The team on the third account (task 40; data/accounts/third.json), from 2026-11-09: its Great League party in party order, in the format of data/alt_team.json. Moves, IVs and levels read off the Pokemon pages and appraisals on 2026-11-09 (level from CP and HP with those IVs). Charged moves are listed in the order of the buttons, left then right (checked against a recording on the first training battles). cp is what the party screen shows.
